newsitem.title: UK: Czarnikow sees record Brazil 96/97 cane production.
newsitem.headline: Czarnikow sees record Brazil 96/97 cane production.

text.p: Brazil's sugar cane production could reach 287 million tonnes in 1996/97 if the north north-east (NNE) season continues to the end of May, Czarnikow Sugar said on Thursday.

Although the NNE crop can finish in March, current information suggested that this season milling could be prolonged with as much as a record 55.0 to 55.5 million tonnes of cane cut by close of operations, it said.
Current expectations were for sugar output to finish at between 3.35 to 3.40 million tonnes raw value.
Heavy rains had interrupted the harvest and hampered field operations during the first 10 days of April, Czarnikow said
But although these had caused delays, they had no doubt helped to boost cane yields and it was clear that the crop was exceeding earlier estimates of 50 million tonnes by quite a margin, it added.
